verdict.rationale: Better Stack is a SaaS observability and incident-management platform. Publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions open-source code, a public repository, or an open license; it only covers APIs, an MCP server, and Terraform integration, which are not source openness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
